label: Andrea del Verrocchio

claims.statement: Painter, sculptor and goldsmith whose workshop trained Leonardo. A 1476 record places Leonardo in his household. The start of the relationship is estimated.

value.text: Denunciation of 9 April 1476 places Leonardo with him

claims.statement: The anonymous denunciation to the Ufficiali di Notte dated 9 April 1476 names 'Lionardo di ser Piero da Vinci' who 'sta con Andrea de Verrochio'. This is the earliest document linking the two.

claims.statement: Vasari states that Leonardo painted an angel in Verrocchio's Baptism of Christ (Uffizi) and that Verrocchio then gave up painting. The statement is Vasari's; the attribution of parts of the panel to Leonardo is an interpretation supported by technical study.
The start of the apprenticeship (often c.1464 to 1469) is not documented; it is estimated from the 1476 record, Vasari's account, and Leonardo's age.
